titel: Kiselev Micro 8088 – First Boot with GLaBIOS (POST Codes)
beschreibung:
First power-on of my self-built Micro 8088 board, an open-source IBM PC/XT compatible mainboard designed by Sergey Kiselev. The board runs GLaBIOS, an open-source BIOS for 8088 PC/XT machines, and the video shows the POST sequence during the very first start.

Full build log, parts list and troubleshooting (German): https://www.fambach.net/?p=14252
Micro 8088 project by Sergey Kiselev: https://github.com/skiselev/micro_8088
GLaBIOS: https://github.com/640-KB/GLaBIOS

titel: The Secret of Monkey Island (1990) – DOS Intro on a Retro PC
beschreibung:
The intro of the classic LucasArts point-and-click adventure The Secret of Monkey Island (1990), started from the DOS prompt on one of my retro PCs: Lucasfilm Games logo, the Island of Mêlée and the title screen with the original credits.
